title: A buffer reaches the gut
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: The pancreas delivers bicarbonate-containing juice to the duodenum, helping neutralize acidic contents arriving from the stomach.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which organ supplies bicarbonate-rich pancreatic juice to the duodenum? The pancreas delivers bicarbonate-containing juice to the duodenum, helping neutralize acidic contents arriving from the stomach.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
